items.line: Mercury: cleverness, humor, curiosity|and a way with words.
Venus: affection, charm, taste, harmony|and the ability to enjoy life.
Mars: courage, passion, decisiveness|and protecting what matters.
Uranus: originality, independence|and the courage to be different.
Pluto: resilience, depth, honesty|and the power to begin again.
